channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Javaris Crittenton | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Javaris Crittenton from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Gilbert Arenas on Javaris Crittenton
item.description:
Gilbert Arenas:

“How many guns did I bring? Four. I had the gold Desert Eagle, and then I had a Smith & Wesson .500. Only Shaq could shoot that one. I knew Javaris wasn’t going to pick it up. It was a revolver—a Dirty Harry gun. There’s no way in hell he was going to pick that one up. That thing would hurt your arm. My thought was simple: They don’t sell bullets in D.C., and he lived in Virginia. The only gun store is in Maryland. Was he really going to go through all that just to get bullets? It was an empty threat anyway.”

Gilbert Arenas on Javaris Crittenton, Dec 27, 2024. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Gilbert Arenas on Javaris Crittenton
item.description:
Gilbert Arenas:

“Javaris got mad and threw one of the guns. That’s what scared everyone. When the gun flew, the trainer freaked out. Even after all that, me and him were sitting in the jacuzzi, talking like, ‘Man, you play too much.’ He was mad over $1,100, but he said it wasn’t about the money—itwas the principle. He told me, ‘You didn’t have to get in the game and mess it up.’ And I said, ‘Hey, you messed it up too, bringing out those two big guns with no bullets.’”

Gilbert Arenas on Javaris Crittenton, Dec 27, 2024. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Gilbert Arenas on Javaris Crittenton
item.description:
“Out of all the players on the team, probably Javaris was the most consistent coming to my room when we landed. Just to talk basketball, watch film, just talk about life, what can he do to improve.”

Gilbert Arenas on Javaris Crittenton, Jun 16, 2020. Source: Washington Post.

item.title: Gilbert Arenas on Javaris Crittenton
item.description:
“The plane lands and now Javaris says to JaVale, ‘So you just gonna let me lose my money like that? You ain’t even gonna be a real n—- and give me a chance to get my money back? Aw hell naw, this is the type of shit that gets you fucked up in these streets.’ Iwas like, ‘Javaris, I will burn your car, while you’re in it. Then we’ll find an extinguisher to help ya ass out,’ and he says, ‘Well, I’ll just shoot you then.’ I said, ‘Man, I’ll bring you the guns to shoot me!’”

Gilbert Arenas on Javaris Crittenton, Aug 7, 2018. Source: Action Network.

item.title: Brendan Haywood on Javaris Crittenton
item.description:
“All the guys I’ve talked to are like, ‘Can you believe this stuff about Javaris?’”

Brendan Haywood on Javaris Crittenton, Aug 30, 2011. Source: Washington Post.
